author: product-requirements-expert
title: Veterinarian JSON endpoint is a supported surface and filters by specialty
summary: Reinstate the machine-readable /vets endpoint as a supported surface returning the veterinarian directory, and let it filter to one specialty via an optional specialty query parameter. Whole-name, case-insensitive match; blank value means unfiltered; no match yields a success response with an empty list.
acceptance_criteria: With no specialty parameter the endpoint returns every veterinarian and their specialties
With a specialty naming a held specialty the endpoint returns only the veterinarians holding it, with a success response
A specialty matching no veterinarian returns a success response with an empty veterinarian list
An empty or whitespace-only specialty returns every veterinarian, as if the parameter were absent
Matching is on the whole specialty name and ignores letter case; a partial name matches no veterinarian
non_goals: Any on-page control (form, dropdown) for the filter
notes: Reinstates the endpoint withdrawn as REQ-VET-002; that id stays withdrawn and is not reused. NG-9 narrowed via adr/2026-08-24-non-goal-vet-directory-filter.md.

author: product-requirements-expert
title: Veterinarian directory page filters by specialty
summary: Let the HTML veterinarian directory page narrow to the veterinarians holding one named specialty via an optional specialty query parameter, paging over the filtered list and carrying the parameter on pagination links. Whole-name, case-insensitive match; blank value means unfiltered; no match yields a normal page with an empty list.
acceptance_criteria: With no specialty parameter the page lists every veterinarian a page at a time, as today
With a specialty naming a held specialty the page lists only the veterinarians holding it, a page at a time
On a filtered directory spanning more than one page, following a pagination link carries the specialty and keeps the next page filtered
A specialty matching no veterinarian shows a normal page with an empty veterinarian list and a success response
An empty or whitespace-only specialty lists every veterinarian, as if the parameter were absent
Matching is on the whole specialty name and ignores letter case; a partial name matches no veterinarian
non_goals: Any on-page control (form, dropdown) for the filter
notes: Reuses the specialty match introduced with REQ-VET-003. Filter is a URL contract only; a visible control is an open follow-up. NG-9 narrowed via adr/2026-08-24-non-goal-vet-directory-filter.md.

author: system-design-expert

The filter is a direct application of the owner last-name search pattern to the vet feature: controller-side strip + blank-means-unfiltered branch, plus a Spring Data derived query on VetRepository. No service layer, no new module, no new dependency; dependency direction (vet -> model only) is unchanged. Durable memory updated in docs/system-design.md: Contracts Implements columns for VetController/VetRepository/Vets, a new 'Specialty filter (both vet surfaces)' note under Contracts, removal of the now-stale 'machine-readable route serves no requirement' Known Defect, and the provenance defect count corrected four->three.
integration_points: VetController.showResourcesVetList (/vets) gains an optional specialty @RequestParam; strip it, and when blank return the existing findAll(), otherwise the filtered query

VetRepository gains Collection<Vet> findDistinctBySpecialties_NameIgnoreCase(String name) — a derived query traversing the vet->specialty many-to-many; keep @Cacheable("vets") to match the sibling read methods
Vets wrapper is unchanged; it now serves REQ-VET-003 and Jackson serializes it via getVetList() for the JSON representation

patterns.description: controller strips the query param and treats blank as the broadest result — mirror this, but note the vet filter must BRANCH to the unfiltered findAll when blank (see risks) rather than pass an empty string to the query
Spring Data derived-query seam; the vet analogue traverses a nested association property (specialties.name) with IgnoreCase for exact whole-name matching

risks.risk: Empty/whitespace specialty: a case-insensitive exact match on "" matches no specialty, so the owner trick of empty-string-means-all does NOT carry over
risks.mitigation: Controller strips the value and, when isBlank(), calls the unfiltered findAll(); only a non-blank value reaches the derived query

risks.risk: The vet->specialty join can return duplicate Vet rows
risks.mitigation: Use findDistinct... so each matching veterinarian appears once

risks.risk: Adding a filtered method under the shared @Cacheable("vets") name
risks.mitigation: SimpleKeyGenerator keys the new method by its args (String, or SimpleKey(String,Pageable)) — distinct in shape from the existing no-arg and Pageable keys, so no collision; vet data is read-only with no eviction (survey Open Question #5), so caching is consistent

notes: No new ADR: the product decision (narrow NG-9, reinstate the endpoint) is already recorded in adr/2026-08-24-non-goal-vet-directory-filter.md, and the technical how is a direct reuse of the owner-search pattern with no hard-to-reverse trade-off. REQ-VET-002 stays withdrawn and its id is not reused. No design-doc-autofix records to audit.
